title: Install the Smartsheet MCP server
snippet:
# Install the Smartsheet MCP server
You can connect various AI assistants to the Smartsheet Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Connected to the Smartsheet MCP server, you can interact with your Smartsheet data using natural language.
**Required plan:** Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management

Here's what a Smartsheet MCP server connection requires:
- Network access to a Smartsheet production server environment
- Valid Smartsheet API token, unless you're connecting an AI tool that supports Smartsheet's OAuth, such as ChatGPT (web or mobile), Claude AI, Claude Desktop, Gemini Enterprise Plus, or Microsoft 365 Copilot.
To create an API token, refer to the [Get started](https://developers.smartsheet.com/api/smartsheet/guides/getting-started#generate-an-api-access-token) article.
- URL for the MCP server production environment in your target region. Refer to the table below.
**Region URLs**
| **Region** | **Environment** | **MCP server URL** |
|---|---|---|
| United States | US production | `https://mcp.smartsheet.com` |
| Europe | EU production | `https://mcp.smartsheet.eu` |
| Australia | AU production | `https://mcp.smartsheet.au` |

title: Quickstart with the MCP server
snippet:
Here you'll connect to Claude Code and use the MCP server as your coding companion to explore sheet structure, understand your data, and prepare for writing API code. (These connection principles work across MCP-compatible AI clients.)
## Step 1: Set an API token environment variable
If you don't already have a Smartsheet API token, generate one following the instructions [here](https://help.smartsheet.com/articles/2482389-generate-API-key).
Then set an environment variable to hold your token value, for referencing in your configuration.
```
export SMARTSHEET_API_TOKEN="token value"
```
The command may vary depending on your operating system and/or shell environment.
## Step 2: Configure your MCP server connection
Use Claude Code's CLI, to configure your connection.
```
claude mcp add --transport http smartsheet-mcp \
https://mcp.smartsheet.com \
-H "Authorization:Bearer ${SMARTSHEET_API_TOKEN}"
```
If you're using a regional server outside of the US, replace the MCP server URL with one for your region:
- For Europe, use `https://mcp.smartsheet.eu`
- For Australia, use `https://mcp.smartsheet.au`

title: Smartsheet MCP server introduction
snippet:
Interact with your project data in Smartsheet using the Smartsheet MCP server connected to Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI clients. Once connected, you can use natural language to read, analyze, and manage Smartsheet data to complement how you make decisions and get work done.
**Required plan:** Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management
> ## 🚀 What's new!
>
>
>
>
>
> - **MCP Connectors for ChatGPT, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Gemini Enterprise Plus, and Amazon Quick:** Work with your Smartsheet projects in [ChatGPT](https://help.smartsheet.com/articles/2483728-use-smartsheet-in-chatgpt), [Microsoft 365 Copilot](https://help.smartsheet.com/articles/2483717-microsoft-copilot-connector) (plus configuration [video](https://help.smartsheet.com/articles/2483726-configure-smartsheet-connector-in-microsoft-copilot)), [Gemini Enterprise Plus](https://help.smartsheet.com/articles/2483725-connect-smartsheet-gemini), and [Amazon Quick](https://help.smartsheet.com/articles/2483732-access-smartsheet-amazon-quick).

Our [Quickstart](https://developers.smartsheet.com/ai-mcp/smartsheet/mcp-quickstart) walks you through connecting the Smartsheet MCP server as an interactive companion in Claude Code. (These connection principles work across MCP-compatible AI clients.)
## Why use the MCP server?
The Smartsheet MCP server bridges the gap between Smartsheet and AI models, allowing you to:
- Access Smartsheet data in real time
- Apply AI reasoning with Smartsheet's project and data management features
- Integrate with popular AI platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Gemini Enterprise Plus, or custom AI clients.
- Automate complex tasks that require both data analysis and decision-making
Instead of manually copying data into an AI or writing custom API integrations, you can connect Smartsheet to AI clients to query projects, transform data, and trigger actions.
## How it works
The MCP server exposes Smartsheet capabilities as tools that AI models can invoke. When you integrate Smartsheet with an AI client:
1. The AI client can access (with your consent) predefined tools to summarize sheets, create rows, update data, and more.
2. The client determines which tools are needed to solve your requests.
3. The MCP server executes the request and returns structured data.
4. The AI client processes the results and provides a response.
This enables natural interactions like: *"Show me all overdue tasks from the Marketing sheet and create a summary report"
